On this special episode of Chart Fanatics, Fabio Valentini and Carmine Rosato trade the New York Open LIVE. Fabio focuses on NASDAQ order flow, speed of tape, big trades and absorption, while Carmine breaks down S&P/ES order flow, zero prints, footprint charts, the CLC rule and market structure demand. This session shows the reality of professional scalping in real time: when to execute, when to stay out, how to manage risk, how to read trapped traders, and why market conditions matter more than forcing trades.
